items.summary_en: Queensland ministers could not say if they have read the Olympic rowing assessment for Rockhampton. The report was made by the Games Independent Infrastructure and Coordination Authority and the marine engineering firm WaterProof. It has not been released to the public.

items.raw_excerpt: One in four Finnish respondents said they started drinking energy drinks before the age of 12.
items.summary_en: Health officials in Nordic countries are worried about energy drinks. One in four people surveyed in Finland said they started drinking them before age 12. They want clearer labels and tighter rules for young children.

items.title_en: Nordic Health Officials Warn About Energy Drinks

items.title_original: Nordic health officials sound alarm over energy drinks

items.raw_excerpt: A tested mix of Monster, Red Bull and espresso contained 282.1mg of caffeine, equivalent to about three cups of brewed coffee.
items.summary_en: Health officials warn teenagers about drinks that mix energy drinks with coffee or matcha. One tested mix had 282.1 mg of caffeine. That is about as much as three cups of brewed coffee.
items.summary_ko: 보건 당국 청소년이 에너지드링크와 커피 또는 마차를 섞어 마시는 것에 대해 경고했다. 한 검사에서 카페인 282.1밀리그램이 나왔는데, 이는 볶은 커피 세 잔 정도의 양이다.

items.raw_excerpt: The bacteria responsible picked up some new genetic material, say experts.
items.summary_en: Scientists studied the bacteria behind a meningitis outbreak in Kent. They found that the germs had gained new genetic material. This change may have made the infection spread more easily.

items.raw_excerpt: The SA government admits that the condition of a Murraylands road is unacceptable despite recent attempts at running repairs.
items.summary_en: A large pothole on a road in South Australia's Murraylands area has survived several repair attempts. A motorcyclist says the hole on Ridley Road near Mannum is very dangerous for riders. The state government admits the road condition is not acceptable.

items.raw_excerpt: Keralam and Tamil Nadu pollution boards to establish a joint protocol for monitoring and preventing cross-border illegal waste dumping.
items.summary_en: The pollution boards of Kerala and Tamil Nadu will write one joint rule. They want to watch illegal waste that is dumped across the state border. The shared plan should help them find and stop the dumping faster.

items.title_en: Kerala and Tamil Nadu to make a joint rule on waste dumping

items.title_original: Cross-border illegal waste dumping: Keralam, T.N. pollution control boards to draw up joint monitoring protocol for better surveillance

items.raw_excerpt: SYDNEY, Sept 22 : Australia prop Taniela Tupou said the Wallabies were looking forward to testing themselves against the best when they put their five-match unbeaten run on the line against the Springboks on Sunday. Tupou's assessment of world champions South Africa would be shared by many in the rugby world
items.summary_en: Australia's rugby team, the Wallabies, will play world champions South Africa on Sunday. The Wallabies have won five matches in a row. Prop Taniela Tupou says the team wants to test itself against the best side in the world.

items.title_en: Wallabies Ready to Test Themselves Against South Africa
